name: advisorppc
description: Work on your real ad accounts: audit Google Ads campaigns, get senior PPC advice, pull performance reports across Google Ads, Google Analytics 4 and Search Console, inspect Tag Manager setups, publish a live Campaign Board and improve landing pages, and, on paid plans with your approval, pause, enable and change budgets, bids and keywords. Also reads YouTube and TikTok Ads. All data goes through the hosted AdvisorPPC connector at mcp.advisorppc.com (browser OAuth).
